reasoning: The package follows standard AUR practices for distributing a pre-built Chromium/Electron application. Sources are pinned with SHA256 checksums from the maintainer's GitHub releases, mitigating swap risks. The PKGBUILD has no top-level execution, and the package() function only installs files and sets the SUID bit on chrome-sandbox. The .install hook performs expected post-install tasks (SUID, AppArmor, cache refreshes) without network calls or obfuscation. Deepseek's complete review correctly identified the package as safe.
disagreement_analysis: The disagreement is purely due to transient tooling errors. The Qwen model failed with an HTTP 400 error when auditing the .install file, forcing an INCONCLUSIVE verdict. The advisory Openrouter model failed to parse the PKGBUILD output. Deepseek successfully audited all files and found no issues.
coverage_issues: Qwen model failed to audit claude-desktop-extra.install due to an HTTP 400 API error.
Openrouter model failed to parse the PKGBUILD decision.
learnings: Implement automatic retries for LLM API errors (e.g., HTTP 400) and output parsing failures to prevent a single transient error from cascading into an INCONCLUSIVE package verdict.
When multiple models are used, a complete and safe review by one model should be able to override an INCONCLUSIVE verdict caused by a tool error in another model for the same file.
